definitions.orbit_and_arc: F2p's solution (results/phase_f2p_lro_three_day_arc_edited.json): epoch state, K, C_T, S_T (C_N, S_N pinned), fit on 2009-260..262, prediction day 263
definitions.fit_interval_F: first to last fit-day range/Doppler measurement time (TDB)
definitions.prediction_interval_P: first to last 263 measurement time (~14..25 h after fit end)
definitions.sampling: 60 s grid over F and P
definitions.difference: Delta(t) = estimate - LOLA, position and velocity, projected on LOLA's own R (r/|r|), N (r x v / |r x v|), T = N x R
definitions.baseline: b = mean of Delta over F, per component
definitions.primary_metric: G_T = RMS over P of g_T (along-track); reported alongside G_R, G_N and the velocity counterparts G_vR, G_vT, G_vN, and the mean of g over P
definitions.shape: linear and quadratic least-squares fits of g_T(t) on [fit end, end of P]; sign and curvature reported
definitions.doppler_projection: d(t) = Delta_v . u, u = unit vector Earth centre -> LRO (Moon-centred positions; ~1 deg from any station line of sight); baseline-relative d(t) - mean_F(d)
definitions.doppler_projection_check: pass-window mean of d for F2p vs LOLA against F2q's 21 F2p - LOLA pass-mean differences; PASS if their RMS difference <= 0.5 mm/s (the per-pass robust scatter of F2o, 0.37-0.86 mm/s)

reference_floor: LOLA's stated accuracy (~10 m total, < 1 m radial). A growth whose 263 size is below it is reported as within the reference accuracy: it cannot be called our defect from the LOLA comparison alone. The dynamics-consistency test E2 does not depend on this floor, because it asks whether our dynamics can follow LOLA's trajectory at all

experiments_in_order.E0_baseline: F2p's parameters, rtol 1e-12: Delta, b, g, G, shape, Doppler projection and its check
experiments_in_order.E1_integrator: same parameters at rtol/atol 1e-13/1e-14 (same force model, shadow-event segmentation). Contribution = change in G_T and in the mean of g_T over P. Negligible if below 5 % of G_T(E0) and below 0.1 m
experiments_in_order.time_scale: no run: the F2 path uses ET (TDB) seconds for both our propagation and the SPK. The bound for a TT-seconds mix-up is the 4-day change of TDB - TT (<= 1.7 ms amplitude, annual) times the 1.6 km/s orbital speed; reported as a bound
experiments_in_order.maneuvers: closed by the SPK comment (no maneuver in the arc); no run
experiments_in_order.E2_fit_to_LOLA: our dynamics (E0's) fitted to LOLA positions over F: estimate epoch state, K, C_T, S_T; C_N, S_N pinned and K/empirical priors as in F2p (F2H priors); 60 s samples, 1 m weight; start from F2p's values; Gauss-Newton/LM with the F2 FD partials; stop on the relative rule (decrement < 1e-3 chi^2) or 10 iterations. Then propagate to P and compute G against LOLA
experiments_in_order.E2_decision: share_dyn = G_T(E2) / G_T(E0). share_dyn <= 0.25: growth is not in the dynamics relative to LOLA -> E2b; share_dyn >= 0.75: dynamics-dominated -> E3, E4; in between: MIXED, run both
experiments_in_order.E2b_state_vs_parameters: two propagations: F2p's epoch state with E2's K/C_T/S_T, and E2's epoch state with F2p's K/C_T/S_T; G_T of each splits the growth between the fit-end state and the extrapolated dynamic parameters (nonlinear; interaction reported)
experiments_in_order.E3_ephemeris_frame: E2 repeated with LOLA's conventions: DE421 planetary ephemeris and the MOON_PA_DE421 gravity frame (nothing else changed). Contribution = G_T(E2) - G_T(E3)
experiments_in_order.E4_gravity: E2 repeated with GRGM1200L (GSFC GRAIL, the family of LOLA's GRGM900C) at N = 300 in the same frame as E2, so only the harmonic content changes. Contribution = G_T(E2) - G_T(E4)
experiments_in_order.E5_srp_shadow: the panel SRP model LOLA used is not implemented, so SRP model form is reported as not testable with existing implementations; the numerical side of shadow crossings is covered by E1. K itself is estimated in E2, never set by hand

explanatory_criteria: a candidate explains growth when it (1) reduces G_T by at least half of the share it is tested against, (2) the removed growth has the sign and shape of g_T(E0) (correlation over P >= 0.8), (3) is of the observed order of magnitude, (4) acts on g, not on the baseline b, (5) reduces the Doppler projection growth in the same proportion (within a factor 2), and (6) is supported by the integrator check or an independent oracle where one exists

classification.E_DYNAMICS_ROOT_CAUSE_IDENTIFIED: one tested candidate meets criteria 1-5 and accounts for >= 75 % of G_T(E0)
classification.E_DYNAMICS_ROOT_CAUSE_PARTIALLY_IDENTIFI: a candidate meets 1-5 but accounts for 25-75 %
classification.E_INITIAL_STATE_DOMINATED: E2 share_dyn <= 0.25 and E2b assigns most of the growth to the epoch state (the extrapolated parameters reported separately; if they dominate, the label is E_INITIAL_STATE_DOMINATED with 'parameters' as the stated sub-cause)
classification.E_MULTIPLE_COMPARABLE_CONTRIBUTORS: two or more candidates each between 25 and 75 % and together >= 75 %
classification.E_DYNAMICS_HYPOTHESES_NOT_SUFFICIENT: share_dyn > 0.25 and the tested candidates together explain < 25 % of it
classification.E_INCONCLUSIVE: only if a validation step fails (Doppler projection check, integrator convergence, E2 fit not converging)
classification.confidence_note: every outcome is stated together with whether G_T(E0) is below LOLA's stated accuracy

not_changed: no production code; no data editing, pass selection, weights, Doppler bias or measurement-model change; no constant, coefficient or parameter set by hand; F2k..F2q results unchanged
